prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: lossless chroma-key source for a production full-body decorative companion vignette on the History list and detail surfaces of My Workout Pal
Primary request: Create one original history-archive tortoise vignette: a calm full-body tortoise walking or standing naturally while carrying one completely closed plain blank folio or archival box. The image is quiet context outside the history content, never a timeline or completion signal. Design a new character; do not copy, trace, extract, crop, or recreate any character from a concept board, hero, or existing pilot asset.
Scene/backdrop: the entire canvas outside the subject must be one perfectly flat, featureless solid RGB #FF00FF chroma-key field from edge to edge. No alpha in this source render. No checkerboard, white patch, cream patch, paper rectangle, floor plane, cast shadow, contact shadow, halo, glow, gradient, texture, or background scene. The magenta field must never enter the animal or prop.
Subject: exactly one original full-body tortoise with complete head, eyes, muzzle, front and rear legs, feet, tail, and shell, relaxed upright walking posture, gentle reflective expression. It carries one simple closed folio or archival box with a fully plain unmarked exterior. The folio/box must be fully closed: no visible pages, paper edges, dates, labels, stamps, tabs, timeline, chart, graph, completion mark, arrows, or symbols. Keep shell patterns natural and decorative only, with no lettering or semantic markings.
Style/medium: hand-inked golden-age theatrical cartoon illustration; lively tapered ink contours, softly brushed flat colors, subtle hand-painted cel shading, rounded expressive animal design, polished production asset, warm field-atlas companion language, but an original character.
Composition/framing: square 1254 by 1254 canvas, complete compact vignette centered with generous safe margins on all sides, at least 12 percent around the outermost shell, head, tail, feet, and folio/box; no crop, cutoff, overlap hiding a limb or prop, detached fragments, or floating pieces.
Lighting/mood: warm gentle illustration lighting contained within the subject only, patient and calm, static low-energy posture, no dramatic motion.
Color palette: warm mineral cream accents, deep teal ink and clothing, restrained coral accent, lichen/olive support, warm brown and olive tortoise shell, neutral mineral folio/box; quiet field-atlas palette. Background is only #FF00FF.
Materials/textures: crisp tapered linework, softly brushed fills, subtle cel-shaded shell, skin, fabric, and paperboard texture inside the subject and folio/box only; exterior of folio/box remains blank and unmarked; no texture on magenta.
Text (verbatim): ""
Constraints: output a lossless PNG chroma-key source with perfectly flat #FF00FF background and no alpha; text-free; no letters, numbers, logo, watermark, emoji, UI, data, private information, chart, timeline, dates, completion, progress, archive label, stamp, arrows, badges, ticks, checkmarks, or semantic symbol; no other characters, no extra props, no exercise equipment, no workout pose, no branded objects, no magenta pixels inside the subject or folio/box, no checkerboard.
Avoid: cropped shell, head, tail, legs, feet, or folio/box; missing eyes or facial features; duplicate limbs; malformed anatomy; visible pages; writing or marks on folio/box; calendar or timeline cues; background shadow; nonuniform magenta; magenta spill into subject; holes; copied pilot character.
Output intent: lossless flat-magenta PNG ready for an ffmpeg-only chromakey background removal pass.
transformation: Generator RGB PNG was first converted to an accepted transparent RGBA source with ffmpeg chromakey 0xff00ff:0.30:0.02; that source was composited over a flat RGB #FF00FF field as a lossless exact chroma PNG, centered in a 1536 by 1536 field, and keyed mechanically again with ffmpeg chromakey 0xff00ff:0.30:0.02; the accepted transparent result was resized source-faithfully to 1024 by 1024 with cwebp quality 86, alpha quality 100, method 6. No concept-board character pixels were extracted or shipped.
